REGISTER CONSTANT COUNT IS ZERO BY CONSTRUCTION: these AME modules are ARM little-endian and the sweep implements the MIPS lui/addiu idiom only; ARM uses movw/movt or literal pools, so regs=0 must not be read as "no register is addressed". A movw/movt sweep is required to fill this column
the ASIC register constants are addresses materialised in code, not proof that each is dereferenced; a `lui`/`addiu` pair can also build a mask or a size
the 4096-QAM surface is reported as strings and symbol names, not as a decoded rate table: the MCS-to-rate mapping requires the register semantics
